title: Been obsessed with Suika game but always wanted different themes/gamemodes, so I made my own. Now published on Google play, pending on the App Store
author: because-potato
selftext:
Name is “Maru Merge” on Google Play Store - would love it if someone was my first download! 

So far I have fruit and planet mode - planning to add food, sports, and more! 

My build flow:

\-Made in Unity for Android and iOS  
\-Codex performed all programming, I did light debugging   
\-I created base SVG art for fruit and planets, Codex on Astra Extra High polished   
\-Ad SDK is UnityAds/IronSRC (ads only pop up with player consent, they can be completely disabled for free by just not accepting ad offers. Ad offers are not popup windows and do not interfere with gameplay at all)

Honestly this was an incredible learning experience. I learned how to make art, integrate sounds/scripts/art, publish a game from the point of clicking “new project” in unity all the way to being published on Android, and more. 

My advice to anyone out there working on a big game they have their heart poured into: Scale down first, start small, learn the process and make something polished and clean from start to finish, publish it, and then pick up where you left off. 

To be a a real “ai game dev” you can’t forget to learn the “game dev” part. 

My other advice: don’t put slop out there. A game is only worth making if you have it in your heart to make it polished and fun and clean. You’re only doing yourself a disservice. Video games are art and deserve the love and attention that indie game devs give their games. Even this tiny little game took me two months to make, because I wanted it to be perfect.
